description: Target frequency and per-node methods for rolling statement results up to coarser periods.

frequency.description:
Target frequency: `quarterly`, `semi_annual` or `annual`. It must be
coarser than the model's periods and hold a whole number of them
(monthly into quarterly, semi-annual or annual; quarterly into
semi-annual or annual; semi-annual into annual).

methods.description:
Rollup method per node id. Nodes not listed are summed, so list
balances as `period_end` and ratios as `formula`.

title: RollupSpec

d_3fa8d82393fc10f6839b.description: How one node's values combine over the source periods of a target period.

oneOf.description:
Sum the source periods: flows such as revenue, expenses and cash flows.
A missing source value leaves the target value missing.

Take the last source period's value: balances such as cash, debt and
equity, and trailing metrics such as last-twelve-month EBITDA.

Re-evaluate the node's formula (and `where` clause) on the rolled-up
values: ratios such as margins, leverage and coverage. Time-series
functions then run at the target frequency, so `lag(x, 1)` is the
prior target period.

d_c3655ecfd9c3fc910677.description:
Period frequency type.

Defines the frequency of periodic schedules (cashflow rolls, return-series
resampling, statement reporting). Each variant carries an implied
"periods-per-year" used by [`PeriodKind::periods_per_year`] and by
downstream annualization helpers in `finstack-quant-analytics`.

`Daily` follows the trading-day convention (252 per year), not the
calendar-day convention (365 per year). Use `Weekly` if you need
calendar-week granularity.

Parses only the canonical snake_case wire values via [`std::str::FromStr`]:
`daily`, `weekly`, `monthly`, `quarterly`, `semi_annual`, and `annual`.
Aliases, whitespace padding and case variants are rejected.

oneOf.description: Daily periods (252 trading days per year by convention)
Weekly periods (ISO 8601 week-year, typically 52 or 53 per year)
